ignoreValues.reason: Inter is declared by the project's own design system: reportGenerator/index.css sets --f:'Inter' in the generated .mil-ui block, and Beranda and Report Generator already render in it. PRODUCT.md records one-family platform coherence as a brand commitment, so changing the face on this one surface would break it. The console did not choose Inter; it inherited it, and this build's only font change was loading the face the system had always asked for.
